referee_caveats_inferred: Only two 450 um segments are tabulated, so the 200 uG value and the 11 +/- 9 deg dispersion are weakly constrained
A single T_dust = 10 K is applied to both bands, although the 450 um region is called warm; this biases mass, density and mu_c
Same N2H+ velocity dispersion is used for both regions, with a beam and extent unrelated to the JCMT segments
Comparison with MHD models is qualitative: one viewing angle, 9 models, no goodness-of-fit, non-uniqueness not tested
ALMA non-detection gives no upper limit on polarization fraction, so it cannot constrain the models
DCF Q=0.5 and the angle-dispersion method have systematic uncertainties not propagated into the quoted errors
